## Summary
- Add AGENT_MODEL_POLICY parsing to provider resolution for default, provider, and route model/reasoning settings.
- Thread resolved models into run-agent-task/acpx, including named-session model setup.
- Add optional model display footers for Sepo comments via AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL or policy display settings.
- Document the configuration and keep review lanes fixed; only review synthesis uses the policy.

## Verification
- npm run build
- node --test dist/__tests__/resolve-agent-provider.test.js dist/__tests__/acpx-adapter.test.js dist/__tests__/response.test.js dist/__tests__/envelope.test.js
- node --test dist/__tests__/post-comment-cli.test.js dist/__tests__/post-response-cli.test.js
- git diff --check

Closes #336

## Notes

- The main score driver is that the implementation satisfies the user’s explicit constraint: it supports model policy and display metadata while keeping reviewer lanes fixed.
- The only rubric-specific concern is maintainability of the new resolver parser living in `.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js`; a later cleanup could move reusable policy semantics into typed source if the pre-runtime build constraint can be handled cleanly.

## Findings

- **WARNING:** `Reuse existing code` is only partially satisfied because nontrivial model-policy validation/resolution now lives in composite-action JS rather than a typed `.agent/src` module. This is not blocking for this PR because provider resolution runs before `setup-agent-runtime`, but it is the smallest useful follow-up if model policy grows.

## Summary of PR/Issue
PR #337 implements configurable Sepo model policy for issue #336. It adds `AGENT_MODEL_POLICY` for provider, model, and reasoning-effort defaults/route overrides, plus `AGENT_DISPLAY_MODEL` for optional run metadata footers. The requested constraint was to avoid changing reviewer lanes, and the PR keeps the Claude/Codex review matrix fixed while applying policy to review synthesis. Docs and focused tests were updated for the new resolver, ACPX model wiring, workflow envelope, and footer formatting.

## Review
Overall judgment: the PR is ready to ship. The current review artifacts and PR state do not support any required branch-change work; remaining reviewer notes are optional coverage or maintainability polish.

| No required branch-change issues | INFO | No unresolved defect needs automated changes. Optional notes include adding a direct Claude named-session model test and considering a future typed resolver helper if model policy grows. |

- Claude raised a minor coverage warning for Claude named-session + model setup; Codex did not treat it as a warning, and rubrics review passed with only a nonblocking maintainability note.
- Existing inline comments and review threads were empty; no new inline comments were posted.
